notes.text: The earlier note retaining G.N. as unresolved is preserved as editorial history. This research locates matching passages in Gilgulei Neshamot, alef 8 and pe 7. The digital transcription’s printed basis remains unspecified. Its pe 7 reads matronita; Heilprin and Halakhot Gedolot read medita, so a definite ethnic translation is held.

The gematria does work under the stated calculation: אריוך מלך = 327; its eight letters plus two inclusive units give 337, equal to שאול. This corrects an earlier reviewer hold; it does not validate the reincarnation interpretation.

The biblical quotations, the midrashic expansion “in my company,” the narrator’s father’s explanation and the compiler’s parentheses are separate voices. Yalkut 80 connects Samuel’s lifetime to Saul’s; it does not assert ordinary biological fatherhood.
